lines.en: This note is too big. How can Mia invite Leo to play?
lines.zh: 纸条过不去。米娅怎么邀请对面的里奥来玩？

lines.en: They share a code. Gold is one. Blue is zero.
lines.zh: 约好一张表。金色是一，蓝色是零。

lines.en: Yes! His screen says PLAY. The invitation got through!
lines.zh: 可以！邀请送到了。一起玩吧！

en.spoken: Yes! His screen says play. The invitation got through!

lines.en: A gift is hidden in one of ten boxes.
lines.zh: 礼物藏在十个箱子里。里奥要找出来。

lines.en: Four yes-or-no answers lead him to box seven.
lines.zh: 四个回答，七号箱找到了！

lines.en: Watermelon! Now it's Leo's turn to send a message.
lines.zh: 是西瓜！这回，轮到里奥回信。

lines.en: Leo presses Send. A gold signal carries his reply: got it!
lines.zh: 他按下发送键，一颗金色小球传了回去：收到啦！

lines.en: What would you send through your tiny pipe?
lines.zh: 如果是你，你想给朋友说什么？
